def settings(keys: list[str], values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Overlay keys[i] = values[i] on the defaults mode=fast and level=3.

    Returns the value of mode, then the value of level, then the values of
    any other keys in order of first appearance. If a key repeats, its last
    value wins and its position is that of its first appearance.
    """
    pre keys.len() == values.len()
    post out.len() >= 2
    ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
    ex settings(["level", "color"], ["5", "red"]) == ["fast", "5", "red"]
    ex settings(["x", "mode", "x"], ["1", "slow", "2"]) == ["slow", "3", "2"]
    mode = "fast"
    level = "3"
    order: list[str] = []
    other: dict[str, str] = {}
    for i in range(keys.len()):
        k = keys[i]
        v = values[i]
        if k == "mode":
            mode = v.copy()
        elif k == "level":
            level = v.copy()
        else:
            if k not in other:
                order.append(k.copy())
            other[k.copy()] = v.copy()
    out: list[str] = [mode.copy(), level.copy()]
    for k in order:
        out.append((other.get(k) else "").copy())
    return out
